title: B-score: Detecting biases in large language models using response history
measurement_description: The paper measured social bias related to religion as one of several categories within the BBQ benchmark to validate its proposed B-score metric. This involved evaluating model preferences in ambiguous binary-choice scenarios.
findings: On ambiguous questions from the BBQ benchmark, which includes a 'Religion' category, LLMs showed extreme bias in single-turn conversations. This bias was significantly reduced in multi-turn settings where the model could see its previous answers. The paper's proposed B-score metric successfully detected this bias, while self-reported confidence scores did not.
